an7.63:1.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an7.63:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesane manussā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā honti.
an7.63:1.3: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ Bhagavā etad avoca
an7.63:2.1: ‘kin nu kho te gahapati nivesane manussā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope' ti?
an7.63:2.2: ‘Ayaṃ bhante Sujātā gharasuṇhā aḍḍhā aḍḍhakulā ānītā,
an7.63:2.3: sā neva sassuṃ ādiyati na sasuraṃ ādiyati na sāmikaṃ ādiyati, Bhagavantam pi na sakkaroti na garukaroti na māneti na pūjeti' ti. 2.
an7.63:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Sujātaṃ gharasuṇhaṃ āmantesi
an7.63:3.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho Sujātā gharasuṇhā Bhagavato paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Sujātaṃ gharasuṇhaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca
an7.63:4.3: Vadhakasamā, corīsamā, ayyasamā, mātusamā, bhaginīsamā, sakhīsamā, dāsīsamā.
an7.63:4.4: Imā kho Sujāte satta purisassa bhariyā.
an7.63:4.6: ‘Na kho ahaṃ bhante imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
an7.63:4.7: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathāhaṃ imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājāneyyan' ti.
an7.63:4.8: ‘Tena hi Sujāte suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an7.63:4.9: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho Sujātā gharasuṇhā Bhagavato paccassosi.
an7.63:5.5: ‘vadhakā ca bhariyā' ti ca sā pavuccati.
an7.63:6.5: ‘corī ca bhariyā' ti ca sā pavuccati.
an7.63:7.5: ‘ayyā ca bhariyā' ti ca sā pavuccati.
an7.63:8.5: ‘mātā ca bhariyā' ti ca sā pavuccati.
an7.63:9.5: ‘bhaginī ca bhariyā' ti ca sā pavuccati.
an7.63:10.5: ‘sakhī ca bhariyā' ti ca sā pavuccati.
an7.63:11.5: ‘dāsī ca bhariyā' ti ca sā pavuccati.
an7.63:12.2: ‘corī ca ayyā' ti ca sā pavuccati
an7.63:13.1: Yā cīdha ‘mātā bhaginī sakhī' ti ca
an7.63:13.2: ‘dāsī ca bhariyā' ti ca sā pavuccati
an7.63:13.4: kāyassa bhedā sugatiṃ vajanti tā ti.
an7.63:14.1: Imā kho Sujāte satta purisassa bhariyā.
an7.63:14.3: Ajja-t-agge maṃ bhante Bhagavā dāsīsamaṃ sāmikassa bhariyaṃ dhāretū ti. 1.
